purpose: Freeze the responsibility boundary between the LiuYao Semantic Router, Semantic Sufficiency, Rule Registry and later ObservationPlan evaluation before creating a fresh 22-route candidate evaluation. This file is an audit/contract artifact, not training, validation, calibration or blind-eval data.

currentValidationSnapshot.note: This is the v0.8/v0.8.1 development Validation snapshot. It has already been inspected repeatedly and must not be reused as the future independent candidate evaluation.

owns: Identify the best supported modern real-world route when the event/question topic itself is semantically identifiable.
Distinguish nearby route meanings such as borrow vs lend, business profit vs bounded transaction completion, and romantic development vs marriage vs existing marriage.
Reject when the route itself is genuinely ambiguous/underspecified or outside the current 22-route inventory.
doesNotOwn: Whether all participants, objects, context slots or other required semantics are present.
Whether a confirmed traditional/modern LiuYao rule exists for that route.
Whether a provisional rule is enabled in normal mode.
Selection of six relatives, Shi/Ying, use-god or observation yao.

owns: Given a known route, determine whether the semantic information required to proceed is complete.
Reject a semantically identifiable but incomplete divination statement without converting it into out-of-scope.
Check route-specific required semantics and a generic non-unknown divination goal/question target.
doesNotOwn: Choosing between competing routes when the event meaning itself is ambiguous.

owns: Map resolved modern semantics to confirmed/provisional LiuYao rules.
Return no_confirmed_rule / no_enabled_confirmed_rule / rule_conflict where applicable.
Resolve the selected rule into primary/role/domain/auxiliary observation structure without changing the modern semantic interpretation.

evaluationOutcomeTaxonomy.meaning: Router identifies a supported route and Sufficiency finds the required semantics complete.
Router identifies a supported route but Sufficiency must stop because required semantic information or a non-unknown divination goal is missing.
The text itself does not determine which supported route is intended; Router must not guess.
The text is semantically clear but belongs to a real-world question type outside the current 22-route inventory.
Modern route is understood, but Rule Registry has no confirmed rule. This is not a Router error.
Modern route is understood, but only a provisional rule is available. This is not a Router error.

findings.finding: Semantic Router inventory has 22 routes, but Semantic Sufficiency currently has requirements for only the original 15 routes.
findings.requiredAction: Add explicit Sufficiency contracts for all seven routes before system/candidate evaluation uses route-known vs insufficient outcomes.

findings.finding: Current Semantic Sufficiency has no generic contract for whether the text actually states a divination goal/question target. Therefore a declarative statement can only be treated as __other__ or accidentally sufficient once route-specific slots are present.
findings.requiredAction: Add a generic non-unknown divination-goal requirement sourced from DivinationIntent rather than making Router reject semantically identifiable declaratives.

findings.finding: business_operation and commercial_transaction must be separated by question meaning, not by the word 买卖. Profit/state of an operating business belongs to business_operation; completion/成交 of a bounded bilateral trade belongs to commercial_transaction.
findings.requiredAction: Keep the route distinction outcome-driven in future datasets and remove any evaluator assumption that 买卖 alone determines either class.

findings.finding: Some relationship_development Validation positives contain only vague relation-development wording and do not identify a romantic route. They should not train/evaluate Router to hallucinate romance.
findings.requiredAction: Do not reuse these rows as positive examples in the fresh candidate evaluation; mark them route_unresolved_underspecified.

findings.finding: Three Validation negatives describe an unambiguous investment liquidation action but contain no actual divination question. Router should still identify investment_liquidation; Sufficiency should stop them for missing divination goal.
findings.requiredAction: Do not reuse them as __other__ in the fresh candidate evaluation.

findings.finding: Borrow/lend/debt-collection/debt-repayment direction is core route semantics and must remain a Router/semantic-argument responsibility, not be deferred to Sufficiency.
findings.requiredAction: Fresh evaluation must include matched directional contrast sets with shared nouns and actors.

findings.finding: Completed background actions do not override the active question proposition. Example: after selling a stock, asking whether price will rise is investment_price_trend, not liquidation.
findings.requiredAction: Fresh evaluation must include background-action/current-question contrast cases.

adjudications.text: 做这项买卖最后有无利润
adjudications.reason: The asked dimension is profit/result of the business activity, not whether a bounded bilateral transaction reaches 成交.

adjudications.text: 做这项买卖以后到底能不能赚钱
adjudications.reason: Profitability question; 买卖 alone must not force commercial_transaction.

adjudications.text: 我做的这门买卖最终收益怎样
adjudications.reason: Profit/state question rather than transaction-completion question.

adjudications.text: 当前这单生意能不能最终做成
adjudications.reason: Bounded single deal + completion outcome.

adjudications.text: 我们之间后面还有没有继续发展的空间
adjudications.reason: No romantic/marriage/current-marriage signal; ordinary friendship/cooperation/romance are all possible.

adjudications.text: 我跟这个人接下来还有进一步的可能吗
adjudications.reason: Specific person is present, but the relation type itself is not identified.

adjudications.text: 我和这个朋友以后能不能发展成恋人
adjudications.reason: Explicit romantic target and a specific counterpart.

adjudications.text: 这段关系还没确定，我们以后能不能在一起
adjudications.reason: 在一起 identifies a romantic-development route, but naked 我们 does not by itself satisfy the existing specific-counterpart contract without context.

adjudications.text: 这只基金我准备全部赎回套现
adjudications.reason: Liquidation semantics are explicit; the missing piece is an actual divination goal/question, which belongs to Sufficiency.

adjudications.text: 这只基金我已经决定明天赎回
adjudications.reason: Known liquidation route, but declarative only.

adjudications.text: 我准备把这笔股票仓位全部清掉
adjudications.reason: Known liquidation route, but declarative only.

adjudications.text: 我和普通朋友以后还能不能一直关系很好
adjudications.reason: Explicit ordinary friendship is outside the current romantic/marriage route inventory.

adjudications.text: 我跟同事以后会不会变得更亲近
adjudications.reason: Explicit colleague relation is not a supported romantic/marriage route.

adjudications.text: 我自用的旧平板挂二手能不能卖出去
adjudications.reason: Personal second-hand sale is not inventory_sale or commercial_transaction in the current inventory.

adjudications.text: 家里闲置的旧家具能不能转手卖掉
adjudications.reason: Personal disposal is outside current commercial inventory-sale semantics.

adjudications.text: 护照申请这次能不能批准
adjudications.reason: Approval wording without borrowing/loan semantics must not activate borrow_money.

adjudications.text: 我向同事借钱这次能不能借到
adjudications.reason: Funds move from counterparty to querent.

adjudications.text: 朋友向我借钱我现在借给他合适吗
adjudications.reason: Funds move from querent to counterparty.

adjudications.text: 以前借给同事的钱现在能不能收回来
adjudications.reason: Existing receivable owed to querent.

adjudications.text: 我欠银行的贷款年底前能不能结清
adjudications.reason: Querent owes the debt and asks about repayment/settlement.

adjudications.text: 我已经卖完股票了，接下来价格会不会涨
adjudications.reason: The completed sale is background; the active proposition asks future price trend.

adjudications.text: 我独自经营这个工作室今年能盈利吗
adjudications.reason: Explicit sole operation rules out partnership and asks operating profit.

adjudications.text: 这段关系最终能不能走进婚姻
adjudications.reason: The marriage goal itself identifies the route even if participant details are handled later.

adjudications.text: 已经结婚的我们后面还能不能和好
adjudications.reason: Existing-marriage status is explicit.

adjudications.text: 今年我会遇到对象吗
adjudications.reason: Generic future-romance search has no specific counterpart and is outside the current relationship_development route definition.
